thread:
Mira (CS): Quick sync for Nightshade private deploy week0. High level: network peering done, but two items open: (1) firewall rule for outbound to Redwood control plane, (2) CMK policy needs to allow our role for KMS ops. Audit logs: customer wants 365d retention exported to their S3 prefix 'nightshade/redwood-logs'. Renewal note: expected ramp looks modest; watch for >35% commit for AE outreach.

Tom (Customer): Thanks Mira. We'll expose egress via NAT gateway. Egress CIDR: 3.120.64.0/18. S3 bucket created: ns-redwood-logs. I'll attach policy granting PutObject to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger once you confirm the exact ARN. Monthly CMK rotation ok.

Diego (Network): Copy. Need the TGW attachment ID and private endpoint subnet IDs for the private link. For firewall SR I propose opening outbound TCP 443 to 111.222.0.0/24 (control plane) and TCP 5263 to 111.222.1.0/24 (telemetry). Any objections? We also prefer only allowing our healthchecks from your LB on /live every 30s.

Priya (Security): On CMK: current key policy is locked to account principals. I can add a targeted statement for Redwood role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger. Draft allow snippet: `{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`. Will post full diff to ticket NSH-301. Also recommend enabling CloudTrail log validation for the 365d retention.

OpsBot: Ticket NSH-301 created: "nightshade private deploy - TGW routes, CMK change, firewall SR" assigned to Diego, Priya.

Mira (CS): Action list: 1) Tom to post TGW attachment ID + confirm PutObject policy update (Tom). 2) Diego to file SR for firewall & share expected CIDR ranges in SR (Diego). 3) Priya to push CMK policy diff in NSH-301 and request final ARN confirmation (Priya). 4) I'll note renewal watch and set AE alert at 35% commit. Target: smoke test Friday 11:00 PST.

Tom (Customer): I'll add TGW attachment and subnet IDs today and attach the S3 policy to allow Redwood access. Also will confirm ARN for role aws:arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger in the ticket.

Diego (Network): SR-9009 opened for firewall exceptions to 111.222.0.0/24 and 111.222.1.0/24; opening 443 and 5263 as requested. Will update NSH-301 when approved.

Priya (Security): Posted CMK patch in NSH-301 and asked Tom to confirm final role ARN. Also set note: if they prefer stricter rotation we can propose 90-day cadence.

Mira (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll close the thread unless anything blocks smoke test. Reopen in NSH-301 if CMK or firewall approvals delay us.
